canonical-prompt.txt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production transparent 2D game sprite atlas, exactly FOUR COLUMNS by TWO ROWS, 8 full-body poses, wide landscape 2:1 canvas.
Input image 1: reference for the painterly Brasa game rendering style ONLY, not its badger species or clothing. Invent the specified cat as a distinct companion.

Character: BRUMA, an adult anthropomorphic domestic shorthair CAT with solid neutral SILVER-GRAY fur, soft short coat, broad calm face and a slightly sturdy athletic build about 3.2 heads tall. Clear jade-GREEN irises in both visible eyes. Normal small triangular domestic-cat ears WITHOUT lynx tufts. A long slender silver-gray tail, curved in a compact S close to his body so no pose extends far behind the feet. No white mask, no white chest patch, no blue fur, no lynx spots, no mane.
Identical outfit every pose: cropped sleeveless muted PLUM vest, simple SAGE-GREEN fabric waist sash, warm dark-brown trousers, ivory cloth wrist and ankle wraps, tiny discreet copper fastening at vest. Bare feline paws. No hat, no weapons, no extra accessories.
Style: polished hand-painted gouache fantasy game art, tactile soft fur and cloth, controlled amber rim lighting, subtle teal reflected shadows that do not turn gray fur blue. Clear readable silhouette at small game scale, mature proportions, not a baby mascot, not photoreal, not 3D plastic. Same outfit, eye color, physical scale and anatomy in every pose. RIGHT-facing three-quarter side view throughout, including victory and defeat.

Grid order, left to right:
TOP ROW: 1 calm ready guard idle; 2 same guard breathing in, subtly raised chest; 3 punch windup with elbow drawn back; 4 extended right-facing straight punch.
BOTTOM ROW: 5 recoil from a body hit with paws close to body and tail tucked; 6 low evasive lean/dodge; 7 restrained victorious raised fist, still right-facing; 8 defeated lying on side toward right, tail curled beside legs.
Each pose entirely inside its own invisible cell, standing characters occupy roughly 65 percent of cell height, generous 12 percent transparent gutters. Common planted-feet baseline near 84 percent cell height; fallen character lies near that baseline at the SAME physical scale, never stretched tall. Keep ears, paws, raised fist and full tail clear of every outer edge and neighbor.

Deliver a PNG with a REAL TRANSPARENT ALPHA CHANNEL. Nothing except exactly eight isolated Bruma characters. No background, checkerboard, floor, contact shadow, environment, lettering, labels, divider lines, numbers, particles or glow effects.
movement-prompt.txt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: transparent production 2D game animation atlas, EXACTLY FOUR COLUMNS by FOUR ROWS, 16 full-body poses.
Input image 1 is the LOCKED CANONICAL IDENTITY of Bruma. Preserve this exact silver-gray domestic shorthair cat, jade-GREEN eyes, triangular ears with NO tufts, calm broad face, sturdy adult build, plum vest, sage waist sash, brown trousers, ivory wraps and tiny copper clasp. Preserve the same painterly gouache rendering, amber rim, gray fur that remains neutral gray, and every costume detail. Never turn him blue, white, striped, spotted, a lynx or another species. No new clothes or equipment.

Each cell depicts the SAME physical scale. Standing body is roughly65% of the cell height with 12% clear transparent gutters. Keep every paw, ear and the entire long tail inside its cell. Tail follows the pose and curls closely behind or alongside hips/legs; it must never stretch far backward. All figures face RIGHT in a consistent side-three-quarter view. Adult about3heads tall, not baby/chibi. Same readable green eyes in every open-eyed pose.
Return actual PNG with REAL TRANSPARENT ALPHA. No background, checkerboard, ground, shadow, panels, lettering, numbers, borders, speed lines, particles or external glow. Hands and feet must not cross between cells. Common projected floor baseline near84%cell height. Airborne and fallen poses keep the SAME physical scale as standing; do not enlarge low poses.

MOVEMENT bank, ordered left to right by rows:
ROW1: 1 guard_shift, alert calm ready guard with a slight weight shift; 2 step_back, retreating one controlled short step with guard held; 3 charge_crouch, compact coiled crouch, paws ready; 4 heavy_windup, strong elbow pulled back for a heavy punch, hips rotating.
ROW2: 5 quick_windup, short compact punch preparation; 6 quick_extend, fast straight rightward punch fully extended; 7 follow_through, punch continued with torso rotation; 8 recovery, forearms returning naturally to guard.
ROW3: 9 dash_lean, body leaning forward with tucked elbows; 10 dash_stride, low forward running stride, tail curved close; 11 jump_start, two feet loaded in crouch; 12 jump_apex, midair with knees tucked and guard raised, feet clearly above projected ground.
ROW4: 13 jump_strike, airborne forward punch with body diagonal and legs tucked; 14 jump_fall, descending with legs reaching toward ground; 15 landing, compressed stable landing on feet; 16 guard_settle, resettled calm guard with weight balanced.
All16 poses distinct but anatomically and materially coherent with the canonical Bruma. No magic color change. Keep breathing subtle, punches dynamic and silhouettes compact.
